detail: Bypassing reduce() avoids exhaustiveness ripple, guard bypass docs, and fitness function churn.
summary: Direct state construction with INV-001 exception is cleaner than backdoor SM events for data imports

detail: Breaking data collection into small rounds with z.toJSONSchema()-generated responseSchemas keeps responses focused and schema-validated.
summary: Multi-round Q&A with per-round Zod schemas prevents LLM JSON errors on large payloads

detail: Moving the old directory aside and building fresh state eliminates all naming convention logic.
When the LLM provides paths, the CLI should scan for sibling files the LLM did not mention and ask about them.
summary: CLI should cross-check LLM-provided paths against siblings for completeness

detail: CONVERT_TASK inlined entity creation duplicated quest/epic shapes until review extracted shared builders. Plans for cross-entity operations should include builder extraction as an explicit task.
summary: Cross-entity handlers need shared builder helpers from the start

detail: Adding optional title to overviewItemSchema required conditional spread in every overview producer — missed initially, caught in review round 2.
summary: Additive shared schema changes need a producer audit task in plans

detail: Leaving task:drop as reads stdin cost a refinement iteration. Plans should explicitly name which existing command pattern to follow.
summary: CLI input pattern decisions must be explicit in plans, not deferred

detail: TypeScript overloads with optional params let types phase compile while consumers use old arity. Safer than @ts-expect-error.
summary: Optional-parameter overloads enable incremental type migration across slices

detail: Schema registry drives getJson Zod parsing. Deferring registry updates causes silent data loss on round-trip.
summary: Schema registry changes are load-bearing for reads — update FIRST

detail: Zod .default() only applies via safeParse().data. State cache stores raw ProjectState from before schema changes, so cached data lacks new defaults. After adding defaulted fields, .state-cache.json must be deleted.

buildSliceCompleteResult had a path reference 80+ lines away from others. Caught as CRITICAL in review. Plans changing paths in functions >50 lines should grep for ALL string literals with the old pattern.
summary: Scattered path references in large functions need exhaustive grep enumeration

detail: requireActiveEpic initially loaded full state tree when it only needed project.json. Every caller also loaded full state. Fix: read only the specific file needed.
summary: Helper functions wrapping state access should minimize I/O scope

detail: Slice 02 reviewers flagged context layer changes as necessary for completeness, absorbing most of slice 03 scope. Future epic sequencing should note that independent slices may have scope absorbed by earlier slices during review.
summary: Slice scope can shift during implementation of prior slices
